picks.headline: Eddie AI Overhauled - Pay-As-You-Go Pricing, Editing from Claude and ChatGPT, and an iPhone App
picks.excerpt: Eddie AI drops subscriptions for a credit model and exposes roughly 100 tools over MCP, so editors can drive a rough cut from inside Claude or ChatGPT. Exports still land in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut, and a new iPhone app handles prompts and review on the move.
picks.rationale: Assistant-editor work moves into the chat window and off a subscription — the day's clearest change to how an editor can actually work tomorrow.

picks.headline: New CG software you may have missed: 23 August 2026 (Slapshot Comfy nodes, Topaz Hyperion 2.5)
picks.excerpt: Slapshot's AI rotoscoping, camera tracking, motion-vector and depth tools are now Comfy nodes at $0.25 per processed frame, pulling core VFX prep into generative pipelines. The same roundup covers Topaz Hyperion 2.5 SDR-to-HDR conversion and Postshot 1.1.69 for Gaussian splats.
picks.rationale: Roto, tracking and depth arriving as priced ComfyUI nodes puts a real per-frame number on VFX prep — immediately budgetable for small shops.

picks.headline: Filmmaking research and production courses at ETC use Beeble
picks.excerpt: ProVideo Coalition covers USC's Entertainment Technology Center adopting Beeble's AI relighting and scene-reconstruction stack for its filmmaking research and production courses. It signals AI compositing moving into how the next crew generation is trained.
picks.rationale: AI relighting and scene reconstruction becoming standard coursework at USC is the strongest signal yet that this stack is now baseline crew skill, not an experiment.

picks.headline: HaZ Dulull's 'Astro Burn' Game Comes to Life as AI-Assisted Micro-Series
picks.excerpt: A self-described genAI skeptic turned his retro game into ten daily vertical shorts with Nura Studios on the Showcraft platform, using a locked-down model trained only on his own assets. It is a concrete template for IP-safe AI production and vertical distribution.
picks.rationale: A working, named recipe for IP-safe generative production — own-assets-only model plus vertical release — from a director who started out against it.

picks.headline: Digital (De-)Aging and the Uncanny Valley Problem
picks.excerpt: A craft breakdown of how aging and de-aging actually get built now, from prosthetics through Benjamin Button and Rogue One to today's ML-driven face pipelines. It maps why even expensive AI-assisted work still falls into the uncanny valley, and what supervisors do about it.
picks.rationale: Explains where ML face pipelines still break and why — the craft judgment a supervisor needs before green-lighting a de-aging shot.
